newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight and one-week rates narrow.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight and one-week rates narrow.

text.p: Average overnight and one-week interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell in the private sector on Thursday, when the market is traditionally very liquid.
Overnight rates ranged between 10 and 10 1/8 percent against 10 and 10 3/16 percent on Wednesday, bankers said.
One-week rates on the pound were between 10 1/4 and 10 1/8 percent from 10 1/4 and 10 5/16 on Wednesday.
Public-sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
